title: Venezuelan Juicy Chicken Bake
description: A flavorful and moist chicken dish inspired by Venezuelan cuisine. This recipe combines the juiciness of chicken with the savory taste of olives.
instructions: Rinse the chicken breast and pat dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Rub the garlic-herb mixture all over the chicken breast.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breast for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Remove the chicken from the oven and top with olives.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
